title: 2-Hour Chicago Lakefront & Museum Campus Segway Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children (age 12-17) must be accompanied by an adult
Dress code is for an outdoor activity. Please wear close-toed shoes and layers depending on the season. Ponchos will be provided if it rains.
Tours and training are conducted in English
Participants must be able to stand unassisted for the duration of the tour and must be able to ascend a flight of stairs without assistance.
Operates in all weather conditions. Please dress appropriately.
All participants are required to sign a waiver and release form.
Groups larger than 8 will either be split up or need to be booked as a private tour.
This tour requires at least two guests in order to begin. Single riders should call or text for availability.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Looking for fun things to do in Chicago? Look no further! Join one of our professional guides on a scenic 6-8 mile Chicago Segway tour. Glide effortlessly through the fragrant garden paths of Grant Park to marvel at the iconic Buckingham Fountain. Enjoy the breeze as you explore the city's top attractions along the Chicago lakefront, including Museum Campus, with stops near Shedd Aquarium, Field Museum, and the historic Soldier Field, home of the Chicago Bears. This guided Segway tour offers a perfect blend of sightseeing and adventure, providing an unforgettable way to experience Chicago's most popular tourist spots that's great for locals and out of towners!
